Validated via test container - all properties verified in verification queries showing role with (is_superuser=f, can_create_db=f, can_create_role=f, can_login=t) and database ownership confirmed.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Creation is idempotent (guarded against pg_roles/pg_database) — a second apply is a clean no-op
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented idempotency using psql \if conditionals with EXISTS checks against pg_roles and pg_database catalogs. Tested by running the SQL script twice on test container - first run created resources, second run detected existing resources and skipped creation with messages 'Role keycloak already exists (idempotent - skipping creation)' and 'Database keycloak already exists (idempotent - skipping creation)'. No errors on second run.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The role password is taken from a psql variable / env, never hard-coded or committed
completion_promises.evidence: Password is provided via psql variable using -v kc_password='$KC_DB_PASSWORD' and substituted with :'kc_password' syntax. No password appears in the SQL file - it's purely a template that requires the variable at runtime. The SQL file includes usage documentation showing: 'docker exec -i study_tutor_postgres psql -U postgres -v kc_password="$KC_DB_PASSWORD" < deploy/keycloak/init-keycloak-db.sql'. Tested with KC_DB_PASSWORD environment variable passed to docker exec.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The script includes/documents the least-privilege proof: the keycloak role is denied SELECT on study_tutor learner tables and can reach only its own keycloak database
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented least-privilege isolation in section 3 of SQL with: (1) REVOKE ALL on both databases from PUBLIC, (2) GRANT CONNECT only to owning roles, (3) Explicit REVOKE ALL from keycloak on study_tutor, (4) Symmetric REVOKE ALL from study_tutor on keycloak. Section 4 includes verification queries showing privilege table with expected isolation (keycloak can_connect to keycloak=t, to study_tutor=f). Section 5 documents the negative proof command. Validated via test container - 'psql -U keycloak -d study_tutor' returns 'FATAL: permission denied for database study_tutor'.
